title: Mixed Volumes, the Wigner Caustic, and Isoperimetric Inequalities
summary: Let $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be a convex body and $C=\frac12(K+(-K))$ its central symmetral. We study the defects $\mathcal A_k(K)=W_{n-k}(C)-W_{n-k}(K)$ through the even--odd decomposition of the support function. We derive exact even mixed-volume expansions, identify their Krawtchouk transform with the mixed difference-body coefficients, and obtain a Kubota formula expressing each defect as the averaged symmetrization gain of projections.
